target.title: fix(mcp-grant): guard sessionKey.trim() against undefined input
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

\`mintAttachGrant\` called \`params.sessionKey.trim()\` assuming the parameter is always a string, but the caller in \`attach.ts\` resolves it via \`readString(grantParams, "sessionKey") ?? resolveMainSessionKey(...)\`. If both sources return \`undefined\`, the \`.trim()\` call throws \`TypeError\` instead of reaching the existing \`if (!sessionKey)\` validation guard.

## Why This Change Was Made

Replace \`params.sessionKey.trim()\` with \`params.sessionKey?.trim() ?? ""\` so that \`undefined\` flows through to the existing validation check instead of crashing.

## User Impact

Prevents an unhandled TypeError crash when MCP loopback grants are requested without a valid session key.

## Evidence

- Source-level: caller at \`attach.ts:39\` uses \`??\` which can yield \`undefined\`
